## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-OFF — Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (Energy, Materials, Utilities). Confirmations: sector breadth ≤4/11 and Financials + Industrials both negative; Leadership narrow with Energy/Materials dominating the Top 5 (Leadership: Narrow — 3/5 Energy, 2/5 Materials).  

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +4.67% | 1M: +14.66%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +7.97% | 1M: -17.75%) RECOVERY. Utilities showing tactical strength: CEG (1W: +6.92% | 1M: -6.70%) RECOVERY.  

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Technology weak: GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -11.19%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft: JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -7.61%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.02% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary under pressure: AMZN (1W: -2.94% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -11.44%) BELOW TREND.  

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +25.28%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +7.97% | 1M: -17.75%) RECOVERY, EOG (1W: +7.81% | 1M: +23.47%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 concentrated in Energy/Materials).  

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -7.09%) BELOW TREND, DIS (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -12.44%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -11.46%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -10.11%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -8.59% | 1M: +5.58%) CORRECTION — Weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology names.  

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: SLB (1W: +14.73%), DOW (1W: +11.38%), MPC (1W: +8.33%), FCX (1W: +7.97%), EOG (1W: +7.81%); Minor divergence observed (AAPL, FCX, INTU show 1W ≠ 1M patterns) — note this is a minor divergence, not a regime breaker.  

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Technology: broadly weak and under pressure with multiple leaders BELOW TREND — AAPL (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -8.85%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -9.39%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W performance: -4.56% (tech weakness).  

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials: soft across majors and BELOW TREND — JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -7.61%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.02% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -2.43% | 1M: -5.93%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W performance: -1.46% (negative breadth).  

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare mixed with defensive threads but overall softness: JNJ (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -1.24%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -6.01% | 1M: -8.94%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -14.07%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: +0.26% | 1M: -0.22%) RECOVERY — sector 1W: -0.74% (not leading).  

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
In a RISK-OFF environment favor reduced-beta, cash-flow defensive names and selective exposure to Utilities and high-quality Energy producers while reducing exposure to high-multiple Technology and broadly weak Financials. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt tempered by risk-off positioning; be selective given narrow leadership.  

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through.  
BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -7.09%) BELOW TREND — watch downside continuation and sentiment flows.  

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +7.06%, Breadth: sector positive) and Materials (1W: +4.91%) for continued leadership; BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.56%) and Financials (1W: -1.46%) for downside risk.  

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA short-term support — failure to hold recent 1W pivot would confirm continued selling pressure given BELOW TREND posture; AAPL holding RECOVERY pivot (~1W recent support) would signal stabilization; XOM sustainment above recent highs would confirm Energy continuation (ABOVE TREND).  

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
JNJ (+80): J&J Darzalex injectable approval — JNJ (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -1.24%) RECOVERY, sentiment confirmed by price uptick.  
OXY (+55): CEO transition and asset sale headlines — OXY (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +27.61%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment largely confirmed.  
EL (+60): talks on business combination with Puig — EL (1W: -21.75% | 1M: -39.73%) BELOW TREND, sentiment diverging from sharp price decline (distribution).  

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
GOOGL (-85): YouTube liability verdict — GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirming downside.  
META (-75): lawsuit fallout — META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirming heavy outflow.  
UNH (-55): breakup bill and legal risks — UNH (1W: -6.01% | 1M: -8.94%) BELOW TREND, sentiment aligned with price pressure.  

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Value/Cyclical style.  
Energy and Materials showing relative strength — XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%).  
Key risk: narrow leadership and heavy Tech/FAAMG selling (GOOGL, META, MSFT BELOW TREND) with notable sentiment-driven divergences (EL positive headlines yet sharply BELOW TREND).
